name: Dr. David Gerdolle
bio: David was a member of the teaching staff of the University of Nancy between 1993 and 2005 and has been in private practice in Vevey-Montreux since 2006. Her practice is dedicated to minimally invasive dentistry and adhesive techniques. David is a post-graduate university certificate at the University of Paris Garancière and is also involved in research programs on composite resins at the University of Nancy. He regularly gives presentations at various conferences and seminars, leads practical work as well as live patient demonstrations in the field of adhesive and minimally invasive dentistry. As an author or co-author, David has published numerous articles in national and international journals on this topic. David speaks French, English, Spanish and German.
